intro: AI agent systems engineer and technical founder. I have spent the past year on agentic systems and harness engineering, starting while I was finishing high school, where I was also wrestling team captain for two years. For most of that stretch I worked 13 to 14 hours a day on it, around school, my job and wrestling. I work across several harnesses instead of just one: OpenCode and DeepSeek Harness, Claude Desktop and Claude Code, Gemini Antigravity, and ChatGPT Codex. Four single-binary Rust desktop and web applications make up my current releases: Ergon (personal employee agent desk with 12 built-in workflows, live SSE streaming, indexed 5,000-receipt search, routines, and SHA-256 receipts), Fleet (parallel coding-agent mission control with DAG scheduling, multi-step check pipelines, and split diffs), OpenRO (Roblox Studio game builder with 22 game systems, Static Luau Prover, 60fps playable stage, and bidirectional .rbxlx XML), and OpenBell (paper-only Kalshi 15-minute live tape collector, 12-strategy sandbox, and Quant Lab — places no orders; no order-placement code path exists).
